method: Kansas City (Kansas City Board of Election Commissioners, the Jackson County part of the city) Governor votes transcribed from the official county-by-county returns PDF (text extracted with pdftotext; PDFs kept in data/raw/state/2008_MO_GOV_kc/) into one row added to Jackson County 29095; oth = Finkenstadt (LIB) 1,736, Thompson (CST) 1,162, write-ins 2. Needed because Amlani & Algara's Missouri 2008 Governor county rows omit Kansas City (statewide shortfall equals Kansas City exactly).
validation: Amlani statewide dem 1,560,588 + KC 120,023 = 1,680,611 vs certified Jeremiah W. (Jay) Nixon 1,680,611: +0 (+0.00%); Amlani statewide rep 1,110,048 + KC 26,316 = 1,136,364 vs certified Kenny Hulshof 1,136,364: +0 (+0.00%). KC row sums to the official KC total of 149,239.
